jobs.title: HOSPITAL FINANCE COUNSELOR
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Spandana Hospital is a renowned heart and superspeciality hospital headquartered in Bangalore, dedicated to providing world-class healthcare services at an affordable cost. With a highly trained and qualified team, Spandana is committed to delivering the best patient-centered, high-quality tertiary and critical care. As a part of the vibrant healthcare industry, Spandana employs between 201-500 staff members, working tirelessly to meet the needs of society. To learn more, visit our website at https://spandanahospital.care.

Job Overview

The Hospital Finance Counselor at Spandana Hospital will be a vital part of the healthcare finance team, operating from our headquarters in Bangalore. This is a full-time, mid-level position requiring 4 to 6 years of experience in healthcare finance. The role demands expertise in patient financial counseling, understanding health insurance regulations, and managing revenue cycles to ensure financial stability and operational efficiency.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Demonstrated expertise in patient financial counseling (Mandatory skill), ensuring patients understand their payment obligations and available options.
  • Thorough knowledge of health insurance regulations (Mandatory skill) to effectively guide and assist patients with insurance-related inquiries.
  • Proficiency in revenue cycle management (Mandatory skill) to maximize the hospital's financial performance efficiently.
  • Experience with medical billing software to handle billing processes efficiently and accurately.
  • Skill in insurance verification to confirm patient insurance information is accurate and current.
  • Ability to manage accounts receivable effectively, ensuring timely collections and maintaining financial records.
  • Understanding of Medicare and Medicaid to navigate government healthcare programs effectively and assist in compliance.
  • Capability in healthcare financial analytics to interpret financial data and provide insights for strategic decision-making.

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Conduct patient financial counseling sessions to discuss payment options and obligations.
  • Verify patient insurance coverage and ensure proper documentation is maintained for billing purposes.
  • Manage the revenue cycle, including billing, collections, and claims processing to maintain financial health.
  • Collaborate with insurance companies to resolve coverage issues and improve reimbursement rates.
  • Maintain accurate financial records and reports to aid in financial planning and auditing processes.
  • Assist patients with understanding health insurance terms and processes to ensure they receive proper coverage and benefits.
  • Coordinate with clinical departments to ensure financial processes align with patient care objectives.
  • Participate in financial performance reviews and recommend improvements based on data analysis.

jobs.title: Franchisee Relationship Manager
jobs.description:
Organization : QNQ Healthcare pvt Ltd.

Job Title: Franchise Relationship Manager

Location: Saidapet, Chennai.

Working Days : Monday to Saturday (Sunday is weekly off)

Working Hours : 9:00Am to 6:00Pm

Job Purpose:

The Franchise Relationship Manager will act as the main point of contact between the company and its franchisees, ensuring smooth operations, compliance with healthcare regulations, and high standards of patient care. The Franchise Relationship Manager will be responsible for managing and nurturing relationships with pharmacy franchisees, ensuring that each location adheres to corporate policies, regulations, and quality standards. The Franchise Relationship Manager will provide ongoing operational support, help resolve issues, monitor performance, and facilitate the growth and success of our pharmacy franchise network. This is a customer-centric role that requires a strong understanding of pharmacy operations, compliance standards, and franchise management.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Franchisee Relationship Management:

Act as the primary point of contact for pharmacy franchisees, building strong, long-term relationships based on trust and open communication.

Provide ongoing support to franchisees, addressing operational, clinical, and regulatory issues as they arise.

Work closely with franchisees to develop and implement solutions to improve store performance, customer service, and compliance with industry standards.

Foster collaboration between the corporate office and franchisees, ensuring alignment with the company's goals and values.

2. Operational Support & Guidance:

Ensure franchisees operate their pharmacies in line with corporate policies, industry regulations, and best practices.

Provide guidance on operational processes, inventory management, staffing, pharmacy services, and customer care to ensure smooth operations.

Support franchisees in addressing challenges related to inventory management, staffing, and patient care services, including prescription fulfillment and consultations.

Conduct regular site visits to assess operational performance, identify challenges, and recommend improvements in pharmacy management.

3. Compliance & Regulatory Adherence:

Ensure franchisees comply with pharmacy regulations, including those related to medication safety, patient confidentiality (HIPAA), controlled substances, and healthcare laws.

Monitor adherence to pharmacy standards set by the company, ensuring the correct handling of medications, accurate dispensing, and patient safety protocols.

Conduct audits and inspections to ensure franchises meet local, state, and federal pharmacy compliance requirements.

Provide ongoing training and support to franchisees to ensure they remain up-to-date with regulatory changes and compliance requirements.

4. Franchise Performance Monitoring:

Track and evaluate the financial and operational performance of pharmacy franchisees, using key performance indicators (KPIs) such as sales, profit margins, patient satisfaction, and operational efficiency.

Provide regular performance reports and actionable insights to franchisees and senior management.

Analyze franchisee data and identify areas for improvement, offering solutions to optimize business operations, reduce costs, and increase profitability.

Identify opportunities for growth and work with franchisees to set realistic business targets and performance goals.

5. Training & Development:

Coordinate and deliver training programs for franchisees and their staff on pharmacy operations, patient care, sales strategies, and regulatory compliance.

Ensure all franchisees are trained on new product offerings, software updates, inventory management systems, and customer service protocols.

Help franchisees implement best practices in dispensing medication, providing consultations, and managing patient needs.

Continuously assess training needs within the franchise network and develop customized programs to address them.

6. Customer Experience & Patient Care:

Support franchisees in maintaining a high level of patient satisfaction by ensuring quality service, prescription accuracy, and professional consultations.

Address customer complaints, issues, or concerns and work with franchisees to resolve them quickly and efficiently.

Encourage franchisees to build strong customer relationships, providing personalized healthcare services to meet patient needs.

Monitor patient feedback and help franchisees implement strategies to enhance customer loyalty and retention.

7. Marketing & Local Promotions:

Assist franchisees with implementing local marketing and promotional strategies to attract new customers, drive sales, and increase brand awareness.

Collaborate with the marketing team to develop localized marketing materials, campaigns, and digital strategies to support pharmacy franchises.

Ensure that all marketing activities align with corporate branding guidelines and pharmacy regulatory standards.

Analyze the effectiveness of local campaigns and promotions, making recommendations for future improvements.

8. Problem Resolution & Conflict Management:

Serve as the point of escalation for franchisee concerns, conflicts, or issues, resolving them in a professional and timely manner.

Facilitate conflict resolution between the corporate team and franchisees, ensuring that all parties are aligned and satisfied with the outcome.

Address operational, financial, and compliance issues that may arise, providing solutions that benefit both the franchisee and the company.

9. Franchise Growth & Expansion:

Support franchise development teams in the recruitment and onboarding of new pharmacy franchisees.

Assist in setting up new franchise locations, ensuring smooth launch operations and full compliance with company standards.

Help new franchisees integrate into the company's system, providing them with the tools and resources necessary to operate effectively.

Qualifications:

Education:

Bachelor's degree in Pharmacy, Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, or a related field.

A background in pharmacy, healthcare management, or franchise operations is highly preferred.

Experience:

3+ years of experience in franchise management, healthcare, or pharmacy operations, with at least 1-2 years of experience in managing pharmacy franchises.

Strong understanding of pharmacy operations, including dispensing, inventory management, regulatory compliance, and patient care.

Previous experience in providing training, support, and performance management for franchisees.

Familiarity with pharmacy regulations (e.g., HIPAA, FDA, DEA) and healthcare industry standards.

Skills:

Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build rapport and influence franchisees.

Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to address operational, financial, and regulatory challenges.

Analytical skills to assess performance metrics, market trends, and franchisee needs.

Knowledge of pharmacy management software and healthcare management systems.

Ability to work independently and as part of a team, managing multiple priorities effectively.

Detail-oriented, organized, and proactive in addressing issues before they escalate.

About Wellnite

Wellnite is a U.S.-based mental health care company providing accessible, insurance-covered therapy and psychiatry services across multiple states. We work directly with major commercial insurance plans to help patients access high-quality mental health care while ensuring providers are supported with strong operational and revenue infrastructure.

As Wellnite continues to scale, denial management and revenue recovery are critical to sustaining patient access and provider availability. This role plays a direct, measurable impact on company revenue and operational stability.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Director of Denial Management to own and lead Wellnite's U.S. health insurance denial operations. This is a senior leadership role responsible for denial prevention, recovery, and process design across a growing payer mix.

This position is not for entry-level candidates. You must bring deep, hands-on expertise in U.S. medical billing, appeals, recoupments, and receivables, along with the ability to organize teams and create durable systems.

Key Responsibilities
  • Own and resolve recoupments and payer takebacks, including investigation and prevention strategies
  • Draft, review, and standardize appeal letters across commercial and government payers
  • Organize and manage denial-related accounts receivable, ensuring timely follow-up and resolution
  • Analyze and categorize denial reasons (clinical, authorization, eligibility, coding, timely filing, etc.) and drive corrective action
  • Build scalable denial workflows, playbooks, and escalation paths
  • Train, mentor, and manage denial and billing teams
  • Monitor denial trends, recovery rates, and financial exposure
  • Partner cross-functionally with billing, credentialing, provider operations, and leadership
  • Ensure compliance with payer policies and U.S. healthcare regulations

Required Qualifications
  • 5+ years of U.S. medical billing, denial management, or revenue cycle experience
  • Proven experience handling denials, appeals, recoupments, and A/R
  • Strong understanding of commercial and government payer requirements
  • Experience organizing receivables and improving recovery performance
  • Demonstrated ability to lead, train, and scale teams
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and execution-focused
  • Availability to work U.S. business hours (9 hours/day, Monday–Friday)

Preferred (Bonus) Qualifications
  • Experience with mental health or behavioral health billing
  • Background in fast-growing healthcare or multi-state provider organizations
  • Experience building denial management processes from the ground up

What We Offer
  • Competitive, market-aligned salary
  • High ownership and visibility within leadership
  • Opportunity to build and scale a critical revenue function
  • Remote work with consistent U.S. hours
  • A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to mental health care

Who Should Apply

This role is for a seasoned denial management leader who understands payer behavior, knows how to recover revenue at scale, and can teach teams to execute with discipline. If you want ownership, accountability, and impact, this role is built for you.

jobs.title: TL-Enrollment & Billing
jobs.description:
Job Summary

Serve as a team level specialist for enrollment and billing operations in a hybrid night shift role ensuring accurate benefits open enrollment processing and adherence to HIPAA standards for payer and provider clients. Collaborate with cross functional stakeholders to resolve member issues prevent billing discrepancies and support continuous improvement in core healthcare administration services.

Responsibilities

  • Manage day to day enrollment and billing activities for payer and provider accounts to ensure timely and accurate processing of member transactions across multiple systems and files.
  • Coordinate benefits open enrollment cycles by validating eligibility data plan selections and contributions so that members receive correct coverage and billing from the effective date.
  • Monitor inbound eligibility and billing feeds to identify missing inconsistent or duplicate records and drive prompt remediation that prevents downstream financial or service impact.
  • Analyze complex member enrollment scenarios such as multiple coverage changes qualifying life events and retroactive updates to determine appropriate system updates and adjustments.
  • Apply HIPAA standards in every transaction by following privacy safeguards minimum necessary data principles and secure handling of protected health information.
  • Document detailed processing steps exception patterns and resolutions so that the team knowledge base supports faster onboarding and consistent service delivery.
  • Collaborate with payer and provider operations finance and call center teams to resolve enrollment and billing disputes that affect claims adjudication and member satisfaction.
  • Use reporting and dashboards to track work queues error rates turnaround times and backlog so that service level commitments for night shift operations are consistently met.
  • Perform quality checks on enrollment batches and billing runs to verify correct premiums employer contributions and dependent coverage before finalization.
  • Support system configuration activities related to new benefit plans billing rules and enrollment codes so that implementation aligns with client requirements.
  • Communicate clearly with stakeholders through concise status updates issue logs and escalation notes that enable informed decisions during critical enrollment periods.
  • Train and mentor junior team members in standard procedures HIPAA compliant practices and domain specific scenarios so that overall team capability improves steadily.
  • Participate in root cause analysis for recurring enrollment or billing errors and recommend process or configuration changes that reduce rework and financial leakage.

Qualifications

  • Possess four to five years of hands on experience in enrollment and billing operations within healthcare payer and provider environments with consistent exposure to complex member scenarios.
  • Demonstrate strong practical knowledge of benefits open enrollment processes including eligibility intake plan mapping rate structures and effective date rules.
  • Exhibit advanced understanding of HIPAA regulations as they apply to enrollment billing and data exchange so that compliance risks are proactively mitigated.
  • Show proven ability to interpret payer and provider business rules benefit designs and contract terms and translate them into accurate enrollment and billing outcomes.
  • Display proficiency with spreadsheets ticketing tools and enrollment platforms to analyze data files reconcile discrepancies and document case work thoroughly.
  • Communicate effectively in written and spoken form during night shift hours with global stakeholders to clarify requirements and resolve issues without service delays.
  • Adapt quickly to changing client needs peak open enrollment volumes and new plan year configurations while maintaining high quality and attention to detail.

jobs.title: AR Specialist I
jobs.description:
Who We Are Looking For

It's hard out there for a physical therapist—especially when it comes to getting paid what he or she deserves. That's why we need an energetic, motivated self-starter who can advocate for these stellar healthcare providers and make sure they receive every dollar bill they earn. As a WebPT A/R Specialist, you will actively participate in collections procedures, research, appeal claim denials, and generate claim resubmissions for assigned accounts.

What You'll Be Doing As A Part of Our Team

  • Pursue full contractual reimbursement on behalf of our members. Tasks include:
    • Obtain claim status via phone or internet
    • Resolve accounts quickly and accurately, obtaining maximum reimbursement, and perform investigative follow up tasks in a fast-paced environment
    • Conduct research, including sometimes contacting patients, insurance carriers, and claim adjusters.
    • Claim Appeals
    • Responding to insurance carrier correspondence or inquires
  • Timely and accurate follow-up on denials and appeals
  • Consistently meet or exceed productivity and quality standards.
  • Work independently or as a member of a team to achieve and maintain SLA metrics set by the AR Department.
  • Identify opportunities for member, system, and process improvements and submit to team lead.
  • Adhere to all HIPAA guidelines and regulations keeping all of the data in our system safe and secure.
  • Reliable and punctual in reporting for work and taking designated breaks.
  • WebPT Accounts Receivable Specialist I reports to the Accounts Receivable Lead.

What You Should Have To Qualify

  • At least two years of experience in full-cycle medical billing or schooling
  • At least three years of customer service experience
  • Healthcare compliance and terminology knowledge
  • Knowledge of insurance guidelines—especially those associated with Medicare and Medicaid—as well as ICD-10 and CPT codes.

Ideally, You Would Also Have These


  • Critical and analytical thinking skills to help resolve billing issues and collect payments.
  • Excellent communication skills both written and verbal.
  • Experience in the rehab therapy community and the day-to-day operations of a large PT, OT, or SLP clinic is preferred but not required.
  • Be passionate about quality customer service.
  • Detail oriented, good organizational skills, and ability to be a team player
  • Proficiency in Google Workspace

Culture is at our Core


  • Service: Create Raving Fans
  • Accountability: Follow Up; Own Up
  • Attitude: Possess True Grit
  • Personality: Be Minty
  • Work Ethic: Be Rock Solid
  • Community Outreach: Give Back
  • Health and Wellness: Live Better
  • Resource Efficiency: Do Más With Menos

About Us


Here, we work hard—but we have lots of fun doing it. We believe in equal opportunity for all, autonomy, trailblazing, and always doing right by our Members. Most importantly, though, we believe in empowering rehab therapy professionals to achieve greatness in practice. So, if you're a can-do kinda person who loves to help Members win and enjoys working from just about anywhere—then you'll fit right in. We've got big plans, but we can't achieve them without you. Join us, and let's achieve greatness.

jobs.description:
NEOLYTIX

Healthcare Management Services

  • Gurugram
  • Manila Manager, Digital Marketing Operations Neolytix Growth Services | Gurugram, India | Full-Time - US SHIFT | Reports to: VP, Neolytix Growth Services LOCATION

5–8 YearsWORK MODE

Work from Office

About Neolytix

Neolytix is a US-headquartered healthcare management services organization supporting 270+ provider organizations across the United States. Our services span Credentialing, Revenue Cycle Management, Patient Access, Payer Contract Analytics, and Growth Services — delivered from Chicago, Gurugram, and Manila.

Neolytix Growth Services (NGS) is our dedicated healthcare marketing and patient acquisition division. We help US medical practices, clinics, and health systems attract and retain patients through digital marketing, reputation management, referral network development, and patient engagement campaigns. NGS is in a high-growth phase, adding new clients monthly and scaling its delivery operations to match.

THE ROLE

We're looking for someone who can own the operational engine behind a growing healthcare marketing agency. This isn't a channel specialist role — you won't be the person optimising a single client's Google Ads account. You'll be the person who ensures that eight, twelve, eventually twenty-plus client engagements all run on time, on quality, and on budget. You'll build the delivery processes, manage the team, coordinate across geographies, and serve as the operational counterpart to a commercially-focused VP who is out selling new business.

If you've spent your career at digital agencies and are ready to move from execution to operations leadership — from running campaigns to running a delivery organisation — this is the role.

What You'll Own

Client Delivery Operations

  • End-to-end delivery management across the full NGS client portfolio: SEO, paid media, content marketing, reputation management, email/SMS patient engagement, and dormant patient reactivation campaigns
  • SLA adherence, first-pass quality rates, revision rates, and client satisfaction across all active engagements
  • Client onboarding: building and running a repeatable onboarding engine that takes a new client from signed contract to first deliverable within a defined timeline

Process Architecture & Scalability

  • Build and document delivery SOPs for every service in the NGS portfolio — these are the playbooks your team runs on and what allows you to scale without personally touching every deliverable
  • Design and maintain a QA system with SLA tracking, revision rate monitoring, and client satisfaction trending
  • Capacity management: know at any given moment how many concurrent clients your team can handle, where bottlenecks are forming, and when to flag a hire

Team Leadership

  • Manage and grow a delivery team spanning channel specialists (SEO, paid media, content, reputation, patient engagement) based in India
  • Coordinate cross-geography with our Patient Access Services team in Manila for outbound calling campaigns, SMS execution, and referral network outreach
  • Build the hiring pipeline for delivery roles as NGS scales — define profiles, participate in interviews, and onboard new team members

Client Reporting & Intelligence

  • Own the client reporting cadence: build dashboards, write performance summaries, and deliver actionable insights that the VP can present to clients
  • Track and communicate campaign performance in terms US healthcare clients value: new patient appointments, appointment-to-show rates, cost-per-acquisition, review volume and sentiment

What We're Looking For

You Definitely Have

  • 5–8 years in digital marketing, with at least 3 years in an agency or outsourced marketing delivery environment managing multiple concurrent client engagements
  • Hands-on experience across at least three of: SEO, paid search/social, content marketing, reputation management, email marketing, and marketing automation
  • A track record of building delivery processes, SOPs, or QC frameworks that other people can follow — not just doing the work, but making the work repeatable
  • Experience managing a team of 3+ people, including performance management and workload allocation
  • Strong written and verbal English communication at a standard comfortable for US-facing business correspondence

You Ideally Have

  • Experience working with US or international clients in an offshore delivery model — US time zone overlap, American communication norms, and the quality expectations that come with serving US clients from India
  • Healthcare industry exposure: patient acquisition funnels, reputation management for medical practices, healthcare compliance awareness
  • Familiarity with agency tools: Google Analytics/GA4, Google Ads, Meta Business Suite, SEMrush or Ahrefs, AgencyAnalytics or similar reporting platforms, HubSpot or equivalent marketing automation

You Might Not Realise We Value

  • The instinct to systematise. When you solve a problem once, you write the SOP so nobody has to solve it again. This matters more to us than any specific channel expertise
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity. NGS is scaling rapidly — some processes don't exist yet. If you need a fully built playbook to operate, this isn't the right fit. If you're the person who builds the playbook, it is
  • Cross-cultural fluency. You'll work daily with colleagues in the US, India, and the Philippines. That requires more than English proficiency — it requires an awareness of how communication styles differ and the ability to adapt

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS — AND WHERE IT GOES

This is the first dedicated delivery operations leadership role for NGS. You're not backfilling someone's position — you're building a function. The commercial side is already in motion with an experienced VP driving new business. What's missing is the operational counterpart who turns signed contracts into running client engagements, and running engagements into a scalable delivery organisation.

The growth trajectory is real and visible. As NGS scales past 15–20 clients, this role evolves into Director of Delivery Operations or Head of Client Operations, with a team spanning multiple geographies and a direct seat at the leadership table. The path from here to running a 20–40 person delivery organisation across India and the Philippines within 18–24 months is not aspirational — it's the plan.

Other Details

  • Location: Gurugram, Haryana (office-based, with flexibility)
  • Benefits: Per Neolytix India policy (health insurance, paid leave, professional development)
  • Working hours: IST with scheduled overlap with US Eastern Time

  • Document procedures, workflows, and operational guidance as needed.

  • Maintain confidentiality and compliance with HIPAA, ERISA, and XO Health policies.

Experience Required:

Description

Job Summary:

The Quality Analyst is responsible for ensuring accuracy, compliance, and efficiency across medical billing processes. This role involves conducting audits, analyzing claims and documentation, identifying improvement opportunities, and collaborating with the team to maintain high standards of billing performance. The Intake Specialist role is a key position supporting US healthcare operations by ensuring accurate and timely processing of patient and provider requests. In this role, you will support healthcare providers, internal clinical teams, and operations teams by collecting, reviewing, and processing information required for healthcare services and prior authorization workflows.

As an Intake Specialist, you will manage healthcare requests received through multiple channels including email, fax, and online platforms. You will be responsible for gathering required documentation, validating information, updating systems accurately, and ensuring requests are processed within defined turnaround times.

This role requires strong communication skills, attention to detail, problem-solving ability, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced healthcare operations environment.

Our goal is to help healthcare teams reduce manual work, improve documentation workflows, and operate more efficiently using practical AI solutions.

About the Role

We are looking for an energetic and ambitious Founder's Office – Growth & GTM to work closely with the founder on growing EchoPad AI.

This role is ideal for someone who wants hands-on exposure to AI products, healthcare technology, startup growth, sales, marketing, customer research, and go-to-market execution.

You will help us identify potential customers, understand the market, test growth ideas, support outreach campaigns, and learn how an early-stage AI product is taken to market.

This is not a routine internship. You will work on real growth initiatives that can directly impact EchoPad AI's customer pipeline and market visibility.

What You Will Work On

  • Researching healthcare organizations, behavioral health practices, clinics, and potential customers
  • Identifying decision-makers such as operations leaders, clinical leaders, practice managers, IT leaders, and executives
  • Building targeted lead lists using LinkedIn, websites, directories, and online research
  • Supporting outbound campaigns through email, LinkedIn, and follow-ups

  • Supporting founder-led customer discovery and market research

  • Finding relevant healthcare events, associations, communities, and partnership opportunities

We are looking for someone who is:

  • Curious about AI, healthcare, startups, business growth, and technology
  • Strong in communication and comfortable reaching out to people
  • Good at research, organizing information, and following up
  • Comfortable using LinkedIn, email, Google Sheets/Excel, and online tools
  • Proactive, disciplined, and willing to learn by doing
  • Interested in how AI products are sold to businesses
  • Able to take ownership and work with limited supervision
  • Excited to work directly with a founder in a fast-moving environment

Good Backgrounds for This Role

This role may be a strong fit for students or recent graduates from:

  • MBA / BBA / Business Administration
  • Marketing / Sales / Growth
  • Healthcare Administration
  • Life Sciences / Healthcare Management
  • Engineering students interested in business or AI products
  • Commerce / Management programs
  • Any strong candidate who wants exposure to AI startup growth

What You Will Learn

During this , you will learn:

  • How an AI healthcare product is taken to market
  • Basics of go-to-market strategy for B2B SaaS products
  • Customer discovery and market research
  • Lead generation and outbound growth
  • Healthcare buyer personas and decision-making process

  • How founders think about growth, revenue, and product-market fit

  • Builds high-quality prospect and account lists
  • Identifies useful healthcare customer segments
  • Helps improve outreach and messaging
  • Tracks growth activities clearly and consistently
  • Follows up without repeated reminders
  • Learns quickly from feedback
  • Brings ideas, energy, and ownership to the role
  • Helps EchoPad AI create more customer conversations

jobs.description:

Deccan AI Experts is a pioneering AI company founded by IIT Bombay and IIM Ahmedabad alumni, with a strong founding team from IITs, NITs, and BITS. We are seeking a Digital Health Solutions Consultant (Freelancer) to support advanced AI evaluation initiatives focused on digital health platforms, healthcare IT, Electronic Health Records (EHR/EMR), telemedicine, clinical workflows, interoperability, healthcare analytics, and AI-generated healthcare content evaluation.

In this role, you will evaluate AI-generated digital health solutions, healthcare workflows, implementation strategies, interoperability recommendations, patient engagement platforms, and technical documentation. Responsibilities

  • Review AI-generated healthcare solution architectures, implementation plans, workflow documentation, interoperability designs, and digital transformation recommendations.

  • Familiarity with interoperability standards such as HL7, FHIR, DICOM, SNOMED CT, ICD-10, CPT, and LOINC.

  • Ability to work independently in a remote, fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with hospitals, healthcare systems, digital health startups, health technology vendors, consulting firms, insurance organizations, public health agencies, or healthcare providers.
  • Experience implementing EHR/EMR systems, telehealth platforms, clinical decision support systems, patient engagement solutions, or healthcare analytics platforms.

  • Familiarity with Generative AI, AI-assisted clinical documentation, AI benchmarking, RLHF (Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback), healthcare AI governance, or clinical decision support AI is highly desirable.

Why Join Us

  • Competitive hourly pay: ₹1,800/hour
  • Fully remote with flexible working hours.
  • Opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge AI initiatives in digital health, healthcare technology, and Generative AI.
  • Exposure to advanced AI systems focused on healthcare transformation, clinical workflows, interoperability, and intelligent healthcare solutions.
  • Flexible project-based opportunities with global teams.
  • Work on next-generation AI solutions supporting hospitals, health systems, digital health companies, healthcare technology providers, consulting firms, and public health organizations.

  • Conduct engaging virtual and in person training sessions that focus on real world payer and provider scenarios to improve accuracy and consistency in daily tasks.

Qualifications

  • embrace a continuous learning mindset by staying informed about regulatory updates and learning trends relevant to HIPAA and benefits administration.
  • work comfortably in cross functional teams that span operations quality compliance and human resources with a focus on shared outcomes and learner success.

jobs.title: NOC Senior Engineer
jobs.description:
Company Introduction

Availity is one of the leading health information networks in the United States, processing more than 4 billion transactions annually and connecting more than two million healthcare providers and over two thousand technology partners to health plans nationwide. Our teams of technology, business, and customer service professionals in Bangalore, India, are working together to transform healthcare delivery in the United States through innovation and collaboration. Our technologists help develop cutting-edge revenue cycle solutions that help hospitals, health systems, and physicians maximize payments and optimize their workflows.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced NOC Senior Engineer to support 24x7 operations, major incident management, cloud infrastructure support, and operational excellence initiatives. This is a senior hands-on role responsible for advanced technical troubleshooting, L3 escalations, proactive monitoring, automation, and ensuring the reliability and availability of critical production systems across cloud, infrastructure, and platform environments.

Roles & Responsibilities

About Availity

Availity is a leading healthcare technology company focused on simplifying healthcare administration and solving real-world challenges for healthcare providers, health plans, and patients. Our technology helps reduce complexity, so providers can spend less time navigating administrative systems and more time focused on patient care.

About Availity India

Availity India is an important part of Availity's global growth journey. Based in Bengaluru, our India teams partner closely with U.S. and global stakeholders across technology, product, operations, customer support, and corporate functions.

Our India organization is being built with a strong focus on ownership, learning, collaboration, engineering excellence, and meaningful business impact. Associates in India have the opportunity to solve complex problems, contribute to global initiatives, and support products and services that are part of the U.S. healthcare ecosystem.

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced NOC Senior Engineer to support 24x7 operations, major incident management, cloud infrastructure support, and operational excellence initiatives. This is a senior hands-on role responsible for advanced technical troubleshooting, L3 escalations, proactive monitoring, automation, and ensuring the reliability and availability of critical production systems across cloud, infrastructure, and platform environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the L3 technical escalation point and senior authority for P1/P2 incidents.
  • Lead incident triage, stabilization, recovery efforts, and operational restoration during major outages.
  • Collaborate with Major Incident Managers, Operations teams, and engineering stakeholders during critical incidents.
  • Ensure adherence to SLA, MTTR, and MTTA targets.
  • Support and execute incident command processes, escalation control, and stakeholder communication.
  • Own proactive monitoring effectiveness across infrastructure, cloud, and platform services.
  • Hands-on experience with monitoring tools, including Splunk, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Grafana, and Prometheus.
  • Manage AWS operational environments including EC2, VPC, Route 53, Security Groups, Load Balancers, CloudWatch, EKS, and RDS.
  • Support Azure operations, Azure SQL, Azure Monitor, and Log Analytics environments.
  • Troubleshoot Linux and Windows server environments.
  • Support Kubernetes (EKS) infrastructure, containerized workloads, and platform reliability.
  • Drive automation and operational efficiency using Terraform, PowerShell, Bash, and Python.
  • Participate in RCA reviews, Problem Management, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Analyze alert noise, optimize monitoring thresholds, and improve operational visibility.
  • Mentor NOC Engineers and provide technical leadership during assigned shifts.
  • Ensure operational continuity through structured shift handovers and follow-the-sun support models.

Required Qualifications

  • 7-10 years of experience in NOC Operations, SRE, Cloud Operations, Infrastructure Support, or Production Support environments.
  • Strong experience handling P1/P2 incidents and serving as an advanced technical escalation point.
  • Hands-on operational experience with AWS cloud services.
  • Experience supporting Azure infrastructure and services.
  • Strong Linux and Windows administration and troubleshooting skills.
  • Hands-on experience with Splunk and enterprise monitoring platforms.
  • Experience with Kubernetes (EKS), containerized environments, and cloud-native operations.
  • Strong understanding of networking concepts including DNS, Routing, Load Balancing, Firewalls, Security Groups, and Connectivity Troubleshooting.
  • Experience with ServiceNow, Jira, or equivalent ITSM platforms.
  • Automation and scripting experience using PowerShell, Bash, Python, or similar technologies.
  • Experience working in 24x7 operational environments with rotational shift models.
  • Strong communication, technical leadership, and collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Grafana, Prometheus, Dynatrace, New Relic, AppDynamics, or Site24x7.
  • Working knowledge of Terraform, Infrastructure as Code, Git, Rundeck, and CI/CD concepts.
  • Understanding IAM, cloud security monitoring, vulnerability management, and security incident response.
  • Exposure to SRE principles, observability engineering, and reliability practices.
  • Experience in Healthcare Technology environments.
  • HIPAA awareness and compliance knowledge.
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional.
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert.
  • Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA).
  • ITIL Foundation Certification.

Why Join Availity India

  • Meaningful impact: Work on solutions that help simplify healthcare administration and support better provider and patient experiences.
  • Global exposure: Partner with U.S. teams and leaders while contributing from India to global business priorities.
  • Learning and growth: Be part of a culture that values continuous learning, mentoring, knowledge sharing, and career development.
  • Flexible work experience: Work in a way that supports productivity, collaboration, and team needs across remote, hybrid, and office-based models.
  • Holistic rewards: Benefit from competitive compensation, health and insurance benefits, paid time off, company holidays, leave benefits, Employee Assistance Program support, and learning programs.
  • Inclusive workplace: Join a casual, collaborative, and inclusive environment where associates are encouraged to bring ideas forward.
  • Office experience: For office-based associates, Availity India provides amenities such as coffee and tea, subsidized meals, recreation areas, and eligible night-shift transportation support.

What To Expect From The Hiring Process

Our hiring process is designed to be transparent and engaging. Depending on the role, it may include application review, recruiter discussion, technical or functional assessment, hiring manager interviews, team or leadership conversations, offer discussion, background verification, and onboarding support.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Availity is committed to building an inclusive workplace where all associates feel valued, respected, and empowered to do their best work. We welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds and encourage individuals who are excited by collaboration, innovation, and meaningful impact to apply.

Eligibility

Video Camera Usage

Availity fosters a collaborative and open culture where communication and engagement are central to our success. As a remote first company, we are also camera-first and provide all associates with camera/video capability to simulate the office environment. If you are not able to use your camera for all virtual meetings, you should not apply for this role.

Having cameras on helps create a more connected, interactive, and productive environment, allowing teams to communicate more effectively and build stronger working relationships. The usage of cameras also enhances security and protects sensitive company information. Video participation is required to ensure that only authorized personnel are present in meetings and to prevent unauthorized access, data breaches, preventing social engineering, or the sharing of confidential information with non-participants.

Associates in India have the opportunity to solve complex problems, contribute to global initiatives, and support products and services that are part of the U.S. healthcare ecosystem.

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced NOC Network Engineer to support 24x7 network operations, incident response, infrastructure monitoring, and cloud networking services across enterprise, cloud, and hybrid environments. This role is responsible for ensuring the availability, reliability, and performance of critical network infrastructure while supporting major incidents, operational excellence initiatives, and continuous service improvements.

The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in cloud networking, routing and switching, network security, observability platforms, and incident management within a global enterprise environment supporting business-critical platforms across multiple regions and time zones.

Key Responsibilities

  • Proactively monitor enterprise and cloud network environments using Splunk, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Grafana, SolarWinds, and other monitoring platforms.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex network incidents involving routing, DNS, connectivity, VPNs, firewalls, load balancers, and cloud networking services.
  • Act as an escalation point for P1/P2 incidents and participate in Major Incident Management (MIM) bridge calls.
  • Drive incident investigation, root cause identification, remediation, and validation through full-service restoration.
  • Manage AWS networking services including VPCs, Route Tables, Transit Gateways, Direct Connect, Security Groups, Route 53, and Load Balancers.
  • Support Azure networking services including VNets, NSGs, VPN Gateway, Azure Firewall, ExpressRoute, and Load Balancers.
  • Troubleshoot hybrid connectivity issues across cloud, on-premises, and third-party environments.
  • Operate and support network security controls including firewalls, WAFs, VPNs, and network access controls.
  • Execute network changes following approved SOPs, change management processes, and operational procedures.
  • Maintain accurate incident updates, escalations, and documentation in ServiceNow or equivalent ITSM platforms.
  • Drive monitoring improvements through alert tuning, dashboard optimization, and operational excellence initiatives.
  • Participate in RCA reviews, Problem Management, and continuous improvement activities.
  • Collaborate with Cloud Engineering, Security, Infrastructure, Operations Centre, and Incident Management teams to ensure service reliability.
  • Support follow-the-sun operations through structured shift handovers and knowledge-sharing practices.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Network Operations, NOC, Infrastructure Operations, or Cloud Operations environments.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience supporting AWS and/or Azure cloud networking services.
  • Strong understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, networking fundamentals, routing, and switching technologies.
  • Experience with BGP, OSPF, routing protocols, and enterprise network troubleshooting.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS VPC, Azure VNet, hybrid cloud networking, VPNs, and load balancing technologies.
  • Experience supporting firewalls, WAFs, network security controls, and access management solutions.
  • Hands-on experience with Splunk and enterprise monitoring platforms.
  • Experience managing and resolving P1/P2 incidents in a 24x7 operational environment.
  • Experience troubleshooting network issues beyond monitoring, including root cause analysis and remediation activities.
  • Experience supporting global customers or platforms across multiple time zones.
  • Knowledge of ITIL processes including Incident, Change, and Problem Management.
  • Experience with ServiceNow, Jira, or equivalent ITSM platforms.
  • Strong communication, troubleshooting, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work in a 24x7 rotational shift model.

Preferred Qualifications

  • AWS Certified Advanced Networking – Specialty, CCNP, or equivalent networking certifications.
  • Experience with Terraform, Infrastructure as Code, and network automation tools.
  • Experience with Python, PowerShell, Ansible, or similar scripting technologies.
  • Experience with Grafana, Prometheus, Dynatrace, New Relic, AppDynamics, or Site24x7.
  • Understanding Kubernetes (EKS) networking and cloud-native networking concepts.
  • Knowledge of Git, CI/CD concepts, and cloud infrastructure deployment practices.
  • Understanding IAM, cloud security monitoring, vulnerability management, and security incident response.
  • Experience in Healthcare Technology environments.
  • HIPAA awareness and compliance knowledge.
  • ITIL Foundation Certification.

Why Join Availity India

  • Meaningful impact: Work on solutions that help simplify healthcare administration and support better provider and patient experiences.
  • Global exposure: Partner with U.S. teams and leaders while contributing from India to global business priorities.
  • Learning and growth: Be part of a culture that values continuous learning, mentoring, knowledge sharing, and career development.
  • Flexible work experience: Work in a way that supports productivity, collaboration, and team needs across remote, hybrid, and office-based models.
  • Holistic rewards: Benefit from competitive compensation, health and insurance benefits, paid time off, company holidays, leave benefits, Employee Assistance Program support, and learning programs.
  • Inclusive workplace: Join a casual, collaborative, and inclusive environment where associates are encouraged to bring ideas forward.
  • Office experience: For office-based associates, Availity India provides amenities such as coffee and tea, subsidized meals, recreation areas, and eligible night-shift transportation support.

What To Expect From The Hiring Process

Our hiring process is designed to be transparent and engaging. Depending on the role, it may include application review, recruiter discussion, technical or functional assessment, hiring manager interviews, team or leadership conversations, offer discussion, background verification, and onboarding support.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Availity is committed to building an inclusive workplace where all associates feel valued, respected, and empowered to do their best work. We welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds and encourage individuals who are excited by collaboration, innovation, and meaningful impact to apply.

Eligibility

Video Camera Usage

Availity fosters a collaborative and open culture where communication and engagement are central to our success. As a remote first company, we are also camera-first and provide all associates with camera/video capability to simulate the office environment. If you are not able to use your camera for all virtual meetings, you should not apply for this role.

Having cameras on helps create a more connected, interactive, and productive environment, allowing teams to communicate more effectively and build stronger working relationships. The usage of cameras also enhances security and protects sensitive company information. Video participation is required to ensure that only authorized personnel are present in meetings and to prevent unauthorized access, data breaches, preventing social engineering, or the sharing of confidential information with non-participants.

Job description:

Overview

This full-time role at Innobot Health requires a focused, motivated, and detail-oriented professional to serve as a Healthcare RCM Collection Specialist. Under the guidance of the Director of RCM, the specialist will be primarily responsible for obtaining the status of submitted claims by accessing payer portals and calling insurance companies. The goal is to accurately determine the current claim disposition and document updates in AdvancedMD or other client-provided systems.

This position is central to ensuring timely reimbursement and uncovering any issues that could delay or prevent payment. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, communicates clearly with payers, and is proficient in documenting complex claim status information for downstream resolution or follow-up.

Responsibilities

●     Essential Duties and Responsibilities

●     Obtain claim status through payer portals and direct phone calls to insurance companies.

Perform other duties as required to support the revenue cycle and operations teams

●     Accurately document claim statuses and next steps into AdvancedMD based on payer responses.

●     Identify claims that require escalation, appeal, or additional information.

●     Communicate with the internal team about issues such as claim rejections, pending documentation, or denials.

●     Maintain a daily log of calls made, claims reviewed, and outcomes achieved.

●     Collaborate with the Quality Auditor to support accurate and timely reporting of RCM performance.

●     Contribute to the development of automated workflows by identifying patterns in payer behavior and data-entry standards.

●     Adhere to payer-specific billing guidelines, HIPAA regulations, and internal documentation standards.

●     Meet daily productivity and quality benchmarks defined by leadership.

●     Provide feedback to leadership on payer trends, claim reprocessing needs, and training opportunities.

 

Qualifications

●     Experience: 1+ year of experience in medical billing, claim follow-up, or RCM preferred.

Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and familiarity with remote work tools.t.

●     Knowledge of AdvancedMD or similar billing software is highly desirable.

●     Strong understanding of insurance claim lifecycles, including eligibility, submission, denial, and adjudication processes.

●     Comfortable speaking with payer representatives and navigating complex IVR systems.

●     Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy in documenting outcomes.

●     Ability to multitask, prioritize assignments, and manage time effectively.

Competencies

●     Communication: Clear and professional verbal and written communication skills.

●     Customer Service: Courteous and solution-oriented when interacting with payers and team members.

●     Problem Solving: Ability to think critically and take initiative in resolving billing issues.

●     Teamwork: Works well independently and as part of a collaborative team.

●     Accountability: Dependable, punctual, and takes responsibility for tasks and deadlines.

●     Adaptability: Comfortable adjusting to evolving payer requirements and internal priorities.

●     Quality Focus: High standards for data accuracy and documentation practices.

Innobot Health is a healthcare automation company focused on solving the toughest RCM challenges using cutting-edge technologies, including RPA. With a mission to reduce administrative burden and empower providers, we work closely with clients to ensure accurate, timely, and optimized revenue recovery. jobs.description:
Job Title: Senior Procurement Executive

Industry: Pharma Manufacturing / Healthcare

Location: Remote

Experience Required: 3–5 Years

Employment Type: Full Time - Contract

About BridgeBSS Health

BridgeBSS Health is a growing pharmaceutical manufacturing startup with operations and business presence across the United States, the United Arab Emirates, and Sri Lanka. We welcome applications from experienced procurement professionals based in India and internationally who are excited to contribute to a collaborative, fast-moving, and globally connected organization.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a proactive, commercially minded, and detail-oriented Senior Procurement Executive to manage and support end-to-end procurement across pharmaceutical manufacturing, healthcare, biomedical engineering, technical projects, and general business requirements.

The successful candidate will work closely with management, engineering, operations, finance, project teams, suppliers, manufacturers, and service providers. This role is ideal for someone who is confident managing technical and commercial documentation, driving vendor follow-ups, and taking ownership of procurement activities in a fully remote environment.

Key Responsibilities

• Manage and support the end-to-end procurement cycle, from requirement clarification and sourcing through evaluation, negotiation, purchase order issuance, delivery, and close-out.

• Source, identify, prequalify, and evaluate local and international suppliers for pharmaceutical, healthcare, biomedical, engineering, laboratory, and general procurement requirements.

• Obtain quotations, prepare detailed commercial and technical comparison sheets, negotiate pricing and terms, and make clear recommendations to management.

• Coordinate tender activities, including document review, compliance checks, submission planning, clarifications, amendments, deadlines, and post-tender follow-up, where applicable.

• Work with vendors, manufacturers, distributors, consultants, and service providers to secure accurate and timely technical and commercial offers.

• Prepare and process purchase orders, approvals, supplier records, contracts, procurement files, and supporting documentation.

• Track orders, production schedules, inspections, FAT/SAT activities where relevant, delivery timelines, invoices, shipping documents, and payment milestones.

• Support procurement of pharmaceutical manufacturing machinery, API process equipment, laboratory equipment, consumables, spare parts, packaging materials, and project services.

• Review specifications, datasheets, drawings, scopes of work, and compliance requirements with internal technical teams and suppliers.

• Support vendor due diligence, supplier qualification, performance monitoring, and corrective follow-up.

• Coordinate import/export activities, freight, customs documentation, insurance, and logistics follow-ups as required.

• Maintain accurate procurement records and management trackers, provide timely status and risk updates, and build trusted supplier and stakeholder relationships while protecting confidentiality and ethical standards.

Preferred Experience

Mandatory

• Strong CAPEX procurement experience, including sourcing and evaluation of capital equipment, machinery, process systems, engineering packages, or major project purchases.

• Professional experience within the pharmaceutical manufacturing industry, specifically supporting API development, API manufacturing, process development, scale-up, or related manufacturing projects.

• Demonstrated ability to work with international suppliers, technical teams, and cross-border commercial and logistics requirements.

Preferred

• Experience sourcing process equipment, laboratory systems, utilities, automation, or engineering services for API facilities.

• Exposure to international shipping, import/export documentation, customs coordination, and supplier quality or compliance documentation.

• Experience working across multiple countries, cultures, and time zones in a remote or hybrid environment

Core Qualifications and Experience

• Bachelor's degree or diploma in Procurement, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare Management, Engineering, Pharmacy, Science, or a related field.

• Approximately 3–5 years of relevant procurement experience; candidates with strong category expertise and clear evidence of ownership may also be considered.

• Sound understanding of sourcing, quotation analysis, total-cost evaluation, purchase orders, vendor coordination, contract documentation, and delivery follow-up.

• Ability to interpret technical specifications and communicate effectively with engineering, scientific, quality, finance, and operations teams.

• Strong commercial judgment, negotiation, coordination, problem-solving, and follow-through.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

Technical and Digital Skills

• Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Teams.

• Ability to prepare professional emails, tender documents, RFQs, bid comparisons, procurement reports, trackers, and management summaries.

• Experience with SharePoint, ERP systems, procurement platforms, document-management systems, or CRM tools is advantageous.

• Comfortable collaborating virtually, maintaining disciplined digital records, and coordinating across time zones.

Working Arrangement

This is a remote contract role. The selected candidate must have a suitable home-working setup, a stable internet connection, and availability for regular online meetings and collaboration through Microsoft Teams, Outlook, SharePoint, and other company-approved platforms. International candidates should be comfortable coordinating with colleagues and suppliers across multiple time zones.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Position: General Physician ( Intern )

Department: Medical / Clinical

Employment Type: Internship  

Location: Bodhgaya, Bihar 

Duration: 6 Months

Reporting To: Senior doctors / Chief Managing Director

Company Description

Vastu Vihar Biotech Pvt. Ltd. is the R&D unit of Technoculture Research, based in Bodhgaya, Bihar, working at the forefront of drug development using ribozyme-based therapies. The organization focuses on pre-clinical and clinical trials targeting diseases such as asthma, psoriasis, and chronic hepatitis. With a mission to contribute meaningfully to human health, the team is committed to combating challenging and long-standing diseases. VV Biotech is steadily progressing toward its goal of developing ribozyme as a core drug molecule and has recently achieved stable, active in vivo and in vitro results. This work involves testing ribozyme molecules with semi-natural lipopeptide vesicles for mRNA cleavage of key chemokines and cytokines.

About the Role

We are looking for a motivated and responsible General Physician Intern to support our medical and healthcare activities. The intern will work under the supervision of experienced medical professionals and gain practical exposure to patient assessment, basic clinical evaluation, preventive healthcare, documentation, and general medical support. The ideal candidate should have good clinical knowledge, strong communication skills, a professional attitude, and a willingness to learn and work in a multidisciplinary environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct basic patient history taking and preliminary assessment under supervision.
  • Assist in recording and monitoring vital signs such as blood pressure, pulse rate, temperature, and oxygen saturation.
  • Support basic physical examinations as directed by the supervising physician.
  • Assist in identifying common signs and symptoms and escalate concerns to the senior physician.
  • Review and maintain patient medical records and clinical documentation.
  • Assist in monitoring patients and following up on their health status.
  • Support preventive healthcare activities, health awareness programs, and routine medical check-ups.
  • Assist in coordinating laboratory investigations and reviewing reports under the supervision of a senior doctor.
  • Maintain confidentiality and ensure proper handling of patient information and medical records.
  • Follow all applicable medical, safety, hygiene, and ethical standards.
  • Coordinate with nursing, laboratory, HR, and other relevant teams for smooth healthcare operations.
  • Assist in emergency response and first-aid support within the scope of training and supervision.
  • Perform other medical and clinical support duties as assigned by the reporting physician.

Eligibility & Qualifications

  • MBBS from a recognized medical institution/university.
  • Internship completion status as per applicable medical regulations.
  • Valid registration with the appropriate medical council, wherever applicable.
  • Fresh MBBS graduates/interns are encouraged to apply.
  • Basic knowledge of general medicine, clinical examination, and patient care.
  • Knowledge of medical documentation and basic computer applications will be an advantage.

Required Skills

  • Good clinical observation and assessment skills.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to interact professionally with patients and employees.
  • Good documentation and record-keeping skills.
  • Ability to work effectively under the guidance of senior medical professionals.
  • Responsible, empathetic, and patient-oriented approach.
  • Good time management and organizational skills.
  • Willingness to learn and adapt to a professional healthcare environment.

Key Learning Opportunities

During the internship, the candidate will gain exposure to:

  • General patient assessment and clinical history taking.
  • Basic physical examination techniques.
  • Preventive and occupational healthcare.
  • Medical documentation and patient records.
  • Basic interpretation of laboratory investigation reports under supervision.
  • Health screening and employee wellness programs.
  • Clinical coordination and healthcare administration.
  • Professional medical ethics and workplace healthcare practices.

jobs.title: Billing Specialist I
jobs.description:
Who We Are Looking For

As a WebPT Junior Billing Specialist, you'll be responsible for successfully filing, collecting, and resubmitting claims via electronic claim submission. You will also act as a lead within the department by assigning and directing work to other team members.

What You'll Be Doing As A Part of Our Team

  • Review, prepare, and submit electronic claims.
  • Diagnose and resolve issues associated with escalated or problematic accounts.
  • Identify and resolve exclusion trends, and follow up and re-submit claims when necessary.
  • Ensure first pass acceptance (FPA) and educate the team on any issues affecting FPA metrics.
  • Maintain strict confidentiality and compliance, adhering to all HIPAA regulations.
  • Perform such clerical functions preparing and stamping department mail and maintaining postage equipment and supplies.
  • Be ready to fly by the seat of your pants. This role is ever-evolving—just like WebPT—so while you don't need to be Cirque du Soleil flexible, we may occasionally ask you to do a few cartwheels, or at least try some things outside of your wheelhouse.

What You Should Have To Qualify


  • Have knowledge of ICD-10 and CPT codes as well as insurance guidelines—especially Medicare and Medicaid.
  • Must demonstrate flexibility and ability to multi-task in a fast paced environment.
  • Attention to detail, suggest areas of improvement.
  • Be organized, ahead of schedule, communicative, accountable
  • Excellent time management skills.
  • Partner and foster working relationships with colleagues, members and vendors as applicable.
  • Be energetic, possess integrity and a positive attitude, and have a hunger for knowledge and a passion for sharing it.
  • Know how to roll up your sleeves. We have a lot of brass tacks here, and we like to get down to em.
  • Jibe with our company culture. We're talkin energy, integrity, positivity, a hunger for knowledge, and a passion for your role and team. Bring all that and a bag of chips. Seriously, though, we love chips.
  • 1-5 years of experience in medical billing.
  • High School Diploma or GED

Ideally, You Would Also Have These


  • Have experience with a variety of medical billing software.
  • Prior working knowledge of ICD-9 (bonus points for ICD-10) and CPT codes as well as insurance guidelines—especially Medicare and Medicaid.

Culture is at our Core


  • Service: Create Raving Fans
  • Accountability: Follow Up; Own Up
  • Attitude: Possess True Grit
  • Personality: Be Minty
  • Work Ethic: Be Rock Solid
  • Community Outreach: Give Back
  • Health and Wellness: Live Better
  • Resource Efficiency: Do Más With Menos

About Us


Here, we work hard—but we have lots of fun doing it. We believe in equal opportunity for all, autonomy, trailblazing, and always doing right by our Members. Most importantly, though, we believe in empowering rehab therapy professionals to achieve greatness in practice. So, if you're a can-do kinda person who loves to help Members win and enjoys working from just about anywhere—then you'll fit right in. We've got big plans, but we can't achieve them without you. Join us, and let's achieve greatness.

jobs.title: Operations Manager-Medical Coding
jobs.description:
Role Summary

The Operations Manager / Senior Operations Manager is responsible for leading day-to-day
medical coding operations, ensuring delivery excellence across productivity, quality,
compliance, and client SLAs. The role involves managing large teams, improving
performance, and acting as a key link between senior leadership and operations teams.

Key Responsibilities

1. End-to-End Operational Ownership

o Own complete delivery of assigned medical coding processes/accounts across
shifts and locations
o Translate client SLAs, quality benchmarks, and productivity targets into daily
execution plans
o Ensure uninterrupted operations through effective manpower planning, workload
distribution, and shift coverage
o Monitor volumes, backlogs, and capacity to proactively mitigate delivery risks
o Act as the primary operational escalation point and ensure timely resolution of
delivery issues

2. Productivity, SLA & Financial Control

o Drive achievement of productivity, accuracy, and utilization targets in line with
business plans
o Monitor SLA, TAT, and throughput metrics to prevent revenue leakage and penalties
o Identify cost optimization opportunities through efficient staffing, cross-skilling, and
utilization control
o Support budget adherence by managing overtime, shrinkage, and resource
allocation.

3. Quality & Compliance Management

o Ensure strict adherence to ICD-10-CM, CPT, HCPCS, payer-specific, and clientdefined coding guidelines
o Review audit scores, error trends, defect leakage, and rework analysis on a
continuous basis
o Partner with Quality and Training teams to drive targeted coaching, refresher
training, and calibration sessions
o Implement and track Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) plans to sustain
quality improvements
o Ensure compliance with HIPAA, PHI handling, and internal data security policies
o Support internal, external, and client audits; ensure timely closure of audit
observations

4. Client & Stakeholder Engagement

o Participate in regular client calls, governance reviews, and operational discussions
o Prepare and present accurate MIS, dashboards, and performance narratives to
clients and leadership
o Manage day-to-day client expectations and ensure transparency in delivery updates
o Handle operational escalations professionally and maintain high client confidence
o Support new client onboarding, scope changes, and transition activities

5. People Leadership & Workforce Management

o Lead, mentor, and develop Team Leads, Assistant Managers, and frontline
supervisors
o Conduct regular performance reviews, coaching sessions, and capability
assessments
o Drive employee engagement, motivation, and retention initiatives
o Identify training needs and coordinate with Training teams for skill enhancement
o Support hiring, onboarding, and certification planning for coding teams
o Build a strong succession pipeline and promote internal talent growth

6. MIS, Analytics & Governance

o Review daily, weekly, and monthly operational MIS and dashboards
o Analyze trends across quality, productivity, attrition, and utilization
o Provide data-driven insights and action plans to senior leadership
o Ensure accuracy, consistency, and timeliness of reporting

7. Process Excellence & Continuous Improvement

o Identify opportunities for process simplification, standardization, and efficiency
improvement
o Lead continuous improvement initiatives using Lean, Six Sigma, or best-practice
frameworks
o Ensure SOPs, workflows, and process documentation are current and followed
o Collaboration with Technology teams for automation and tool-based improvements

8. Risk Management & Business Continuity

o Identify operational, quality, and compliance risks proactively
o Develop mitigation plans to ensure delivery continuity during high volumes or
attrition
o Support business continuity planning and disaster recovery readiness

Requirements

Eligibility & Experience:

• Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Healthcare, Pharmacy or Nursing.
• Master's degree in healthcare management, Hospital Administration, or Business
Administration (MBA) preferred.
• Medical Coding certification (CPC / CCS / CIC) preferred.
• 10+ years of experience in US Healthcare / Medical Coding operations.
• 3-6+ years in a managerial role such as OM / SOM/AM.
• Proven experience managing large-scale, multi-client medical coding operations.
• Demonstrated capability in leading 150+ FTE organizations through multi-layer
leadership structures
